status.main_product: Automated Trade Finance Document Checking Platform
status.scope_reason: The company builds and sells a specialized software platform designed to automate document processing, compliance checks, and rule verification for global trade finance.
status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, TRAYDSTREAM LIMITED is an active private limited company with its registered office located in London.

claims.claim: The company reports its AI-powered platform automates and digitizes trade document checking by validating structured and unstructured data against more than 250,000 global trade and compliance rules, specifically verifying transaction terms for letters of credit and collections.

The company reports that its AI-powered platform, TraydCheck, automatically validates trade documents against ICC UCP 600 and ISBP rules using a proprietary rules engine with over 400,000 permutation variations to flag discrepancies.
claims.note: The name 'TraydCheck' as the specific name of the AI platform is unverified in published sources.

claims.claim: The company reports that its TraydGuard compliance layer integrates automated real-time screening for global sanctions, watchlists, AML indicators, dual-use goods, and trade-based money laundering (TBML) risks, maintaining an asset processing accuracy rate of 99.98% for discrepancies.
claims.note: The compliance layer name 'TraydGuard' is unverified in published sources.

claims.claim: The company announced a strategic partnership with Bolero International in September 2019 to provide automated trade document scrutiny and compliance checking services, enabling users of Bolero's digitization platform to validate transaction documentation through Traydstream's AI tools.

The company reports that its platform can process and ingest SWIFT messages alongside multiple file formats and paper documents for automated trade rules verification and validation against UCP600 and ISBP standards.
The company reports that version 2.0 of its platform utilizes a cloud-native architecture designed to enhance the speed and accuracy of data extraction and classification models.
claims.source: Traydstream Press Release / Deutsche Bank Announcement (August 2022)

claims.claim: The company reports the rollout of the 2.0 version of its AI-powered platform with expanded data extraction models, followed by the 2024 launch of TraydLC Review for automated letter of credit validation, and the 2025 launch of TraydFund, a trade asset sell-down solution co-created with Mashreq's NeoVentures.
claims.source: Traydstream Product Announcements (October 2024, October 2025) & Mashreq Press Release

claims.claim: The company reports an expansion of its solution architecture into a modular suite under TraydMate, comprising TraydCheck, TraydAccess, TraydAnalytics, TraydConnect, TraydFund, and TraydGuard, alongside the appointment of a new Chief Product & Technology Officer in January 2026 to lead its AI platform architecture.
claims.source: Traydstream Solutions Page & Executive Appointment Announcement (January 2026)

claims.claim: Deutsche Bank announced in August 2022 a commitment to integrate the Traydstream automated trade document checking platform into its environment with the intent to subsequently roll it out globally.
Citigroup Inc. announced a collaboration with Traydstream in December 2023 to provide clients with access to its automated trade-document processing capabilities.

The company reports active business operations and client-facing talent across East Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, supported by local job listings for enterprise sales roles in trade hubs like Singapore.
claims.source: Traydstream Career Postings & Regional Executive Briefs

claims.claim: Traydstream LIMITED completed a US$21 million Series B funding round in September 2023, co-led by Pivot Investment Partners and e& capital.
claims.source: Traydstream Official Series B Press Release (September 2023)

claims.claim: The company secured a strategic bridge investment in August 2026 led by NeoVentures (the corporate venture capital arm of Mashreq Bank) and e& capital, following an intermediate US$11 million fundraising round in August 2025.
claims.source: Traydstream Corporate Funding Announcements & Jawlah Reports (August 2025, August 2026)

claims.claim: The company reports supporting more than US$350 billion in trade volumes across over 7 million transactions and processing more than 20 million pages for institutions and corporates in 68 countries.
claims.source: Traydstream Verified Operational Data via Finextra & Dealroom (August 2026)

claims.claim: The company's platform has achieved live, verified implementations with major global institutions, including an extended strategic partnership with Deutsche Bank, an operational rollout with SMBC Bank International, and deployments with Standard Bank Group across Africa and YES Bank in India.
claims.source: Global Trade Review & Traydstream Case Studies / Institutional Announcements

status.current_name: Bay Smart Capital Ventures (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
status.scope_reason: The company operates a digital supply chain and receivables finance platform that provides financing solutions to SMEs.
status.evidence: According to the Singapore FinTech Association directory, Bay Smart Capital Ventures (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. operates the CapBay supply chain finance and peer-to-peer financing platform.

claims.claim: In July 2025, CapBay signed a strategic alliance with Olea Global Pte. Ltd. to expand into international cross-border trade financing for exporters.
In April 2026, the company partnered with CGC Digital to launch a digital guarantee scheme that provides dual-facility Islamic and conventional financing to support underserved firms.
claims.corrected: In April 2026, the company's Malaysian operations, Bay Smart Capital Ventures Sdn. Bhd., partnered with CGC Digital to launch a digital guarantee scheme that provides dual-facility Islamic and conventional financing to support underserved firms.

claims.claim: In April 2026, the company's Malaysian operations, under the parent brand CapBay, launched a strategic digital guarantee scheme in partnership with CGC Digital to offer dual-facility Islamic and conventional financing to micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.

The parent group of Bay Smart Capital Ventures (Singapore) Pte. Ltd., CapBay (Bay Group Holdings Sdn Bhd), announced that it raised US$20 million in its Series A funding round in January 2021, led by Singapore-based venture capital firm KK Fund.
CapBay previously secured approximately US$500,000 during its seed funding round led by KK Fund in 2017.
The company reports facilitating over USD 75 million across more than 2,150 transactions for over 130 underserved SMEs through its Singapore platform.
claims.corrected: The company reports facilitating over USD $650 million across over 26,000 transactions to finance thousands of SMEs through its Singapore platform.

claims.claim: Across the broader CapBay Group, the company reports a cumulative disbursement of over RM 5.6 billion (approximately USD 1.36 billion) to more than 2,600 small and medium-sized enterprise clients since its founding.
